title: Tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="42" ry="6" fill="#2a3a5a"/>

  <!-- rear large wheel -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="17" fill="#243b55"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="12" fill="#3f6d9e"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="5" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <!-- rear wheel treads -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="16.5" fill="none" stroke="#4f8fd1" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 5"/>

  <!-- front small wheel -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="77" r="11" fill="#243b55"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="77" r="7" fill="#3f6d9e"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="77" r="3" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="77" r="10.5" fill="none" stroke="#4f8fd1" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="3.5 4.5"/>

  <!-- tractor body main block -->
  <rect x="22" y="50" width="48" height="20" rx="4" fill="#d9482b"/>
  <rect x="22" y="50" width="48" height="8" rx="4" fill="#e8694f"/>

  <!-- engine hood -->
  <rect x="58" y="45" width="26" height="22" rx="3" fill="#e8694f"/>
  <rect x="58" y="45" width="26" height="6" rx="3" fill="#f28a70"/>

  <!-- cab / driver area -->
  <rect x="26" y="32" width="22" height="20" rx="3" fill="#c73d22"/>
  <rect x="29" y="35" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <rect x="29" y="35" width="16" height="4" rx="2" fill="#a8e0f0"/>

  <!-- cab roof -->
  <rect x="23" y="28" width="28" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#f2b441"/>
  <rect x="23" y="28" width="28" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffd166"/>

  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="66" y="32" width="4" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#8fb8d8"/>
  <rect x="65" y="30" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#b0d4ec"/>

  <!-- exhaust puff -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="26" r="3" fill="#e0f0ff"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="23" r="2" fill="#e0f0ff"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="20" r="1.8" fill="#e0f0ff"/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="55" r="3.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="55" r="1.8" fill="#fff4b0"/>

  <!-- steering wheel glimpse -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="38" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="37" y1="41" x2="37" y2="50" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- fender over rear wheel -->
  <path d="M14 64 Q30 48 46 64" fill="none" stroke="#f2b441" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- hitch -->
  <rect x="16" y="63" width="8" height="5" rx="2" fill="#8fb8d8"/>

  <!-- rear wheel hub detail -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="2" fill="#a8e0f0"/>
</svg>
